mcqs.question:
With reference to the MEPMA Loan Charge Creation (MLCC) module for urban SHG loans, consider the following statements:

1. From 1 June, all rural SHG loans will be processed only through the MLCC app.
2. The SHG Profiling App recorded 2,74,873 SHGs and 28,39,046 members, with 99.41% coverage and Aadhaar linkage.
mcqs.explanation: Only statement 2 is correct. The SHG Profiling App recorded 2,74,873 SHGs and 28,39,046 members, with 99.41% coverage and Aadhaar linkage. Statement 1 is incorrect because from 1 June, all urban SHG loans—not rural SHG loans—were to be processed through the MLCC app.

mcqs.keyword: Tenure as Premier of Madras Presidency
mcqs.question: During which period was Tanguturi Prakasam the Premier of the Madras Presidency?
mcqs.explanation: Tanguturi Prakasam served as the Premier of the Madras Presidency during 1946–47. The year 1953 is associated with his becoming the first Chief Minister of Andhra State, not with his tenure as Premier of the Madras Presidency.
